description: Use this when the user wants a mind map turned back into a text outline, for example "give me this mind map as an outline" or "export the map as Markdown bullets". Takes the centre topic and nested nodes ({text, children}), up to 300 topics and 6 levels. Returns an indented or Markdown outline that generate_mind_map accepts again, the topic count and depth, and outline and OPML downloads. Does not read images of mind maps or files from other apps.

format.description: indented (default): 2 spaces per level; markdown: "- " bullets with 2 spaces per level.

nodes.description: The map's topics below the centre. Nested topics: [{"text":"Goals","children":[{"text":"Revenue"},{"text":"Hiring"}]}]. Each node has text (up to 120 characters) and optional children.

title.description: Centre topic, e.g. "Product launch". Written as the first line of the outline.

name: outline_from_mind_map
title: Outline from mind map
